title: Aureline M5 kernel-picker-row component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the kernel_picker_row family binds inside the frozen M5 notebook-kernel-output component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-notebook-kernel-output-component-matrix.schema.json). A kernel picker row names what kind of kernel a candidate is and where its selection stands so a picker never collapses kernel kinds into one badge and always offers choose-another-kernel recovery. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
